name: Woman With No Name
source:
Bounty hunter. A female gunslinger, her trademark is her blonde hair. 

No one knows her real name.

She loves using her replica gun: the [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remington_Model_1858]Remington New Model Army[/url].
